slots.palette: warm autumn pastel palette with deep purple night accents
slots.setting: a cozy pumpkin patch harvest festival for cute animals on Halloween night
slots.decorations: Pale straw bales, a few pumpkins, autumn leaves and small wooden crates around the edges of the screen.
slots.background_tones: warm (cream, pale straw, soft pumpkin glow)
slots.kitchen: a little wooden harvest stand with a striped awning and a pumpkin on its roof
slots.loop_interior: a small bed of straw with a few little pumpkins
slots.foods: a candy corn, a caramel apple, a pumpkin cupcake, a slice of pumpkin pie or a ghost-shaped cookie
slots.board_surface: a pale cream wooden table top framed with a thin darker wood border, lit by warm lantern light
slots.obstacles: a small pumpkin, a little cauldron and a candle
slots.mood: playful, cozy and spooky-cute but never scary, with everyone happily eating
slots.night_sky: a deep purple night sky with a big soft moon, only around the outer edges
slots.light_sources: glowing jack-o'-lanterns along the edges, strings of warm orange bulbs above both belts and small candles on the counter
slots.effects: a few tiny friendly bats near the top edge, autumn leaves drifting only at the edges, and a faint low mist in the bottom corners
slots.extra_avoid: scary faces, skulls, mist or leaves over the plates or tickets, orange-tinted tickets
